title: Read receipts
summary: Shows whether people got and read your messages. In a DM: ticks on your own messages for sent, delivered and read. In a group: small avatars of the people who read up to that message, and a sheet that lists them.

tick.description: sending and failed come from the send state. sent: the server has the message. delivered (DM only): a device of the other person acked this event or a newer one (chat.bipe.delivered). read: at least one other person read it (DM), or every other member read it (group). Read wins over delivered.

readers.description: Group only: the people whose newest read receipt is on this message, newest first. Empty in a DM.

avatarUrl.description: mxc URL of the member avatar.

readAt.description: Receipt time, when the server gave one.

nameAmbiguous.description: Another member of the room has the same name after NameNormalizer (bipe#825). The read-by row shows the @ after the name, as in timeline-rows.

isDm.description: RoomInfo.isDm. A DM shows ticks only (ADR 0141).

readReceiptsEnabled.description: The Privacidade switch readReceipts (registries/settings.json), kept on the phone, on by default (ADR 0222). Off: DMs send ReceiptType.ReadPrivate and hide the read tick of others. Groups ignore it.

sheetReaders.description: The open read-by sheet of a group message, newest first. Missing while the sheet is closed.

openReaders.effect: Group only: opens the read-by sheet with every person who read that message or a newer one.

notes: Read receipt type (ADR 0222, supersedes in part ADR 0050): in a group the client always sends ReceiptType.Read and always shows the receipts of others. In a DM the client sends ReceiptType.Read while readReceiptsEnabled is on, and ReceiptType.ReadPrivate while it is off, so the person's own devices still agree on what is read.
Reciprocal (ADR 0222): while readReceiptsEnabled is off, a DM hides the read tick of the other person, so delivered is the highest state shown. Groups always show the reader avatars.
DM (ADR 0141, amended by ADR 0222): ticks only, sent, delivered and read. No avatar row and no read-by sheet. Groups have no delivered tick.

Delivered ack format: a to-device event of type chat.bipe.delivered, content { room_id, event_id }. event_id is the newest event the device got in that room from the other person. The ack goes to every device of the sender (device ID *). It carries IDs only, never message content (ADR 0173).

Ack transport: matrix-sdk-ffi has no to-device API outside the widget driver. The app runs the widget driver with no page, as for calls (spec call), with only the capabilities org.matrix.msc3819.send.to_device:chat.bipe.delivered and org.matrix.msc3819.receive.to_device:chat.bipe.delivered, bound to a DM room. In an encrypted room the driver encrypts the ack with Olm and drops a clear to-device event, so the ack is encrypted. One driver per account receives the acks of every DM.

Ack send: the app's sync, the iOS notification service extension and the Android push handler send the ack when a device gets new DM events from another user. At most one ack per room per batch of events. Acks have no setting and are always sent.

Ack receive: the client accepts chat.bipe.delivered only from the DM's other member (the to-device sender is that user ID) and only for a room that is a DM with that member. It keeps the newest delivered event ID per room on the device only. A new device shows sent until the next ack or read receipt.
An ack covers older events, like a read receipt: an own event is delivered when it or a newer event in the room is the stored delivered event.

EventTimelineItem.readReceipts holds the users whose newest receipt is on that event. A user's read also covers every older message, so the tick of an older own message is read when any newer event has that user's receipt.
Group: the avatar row shows at most 3 avatars and a count; bipe_app_receipt_read_by is its accessibility label, with the count already formatted. Own receipts never show.

Only the newest own message shows its tick label as text; older own messages show the icon only. Screen readers read bipe_app_receipt_sent, bipe_app_receipt_delivered or bipe_app_receipt_read on every own message.
Ticks: sent is one tick, delivered is two ticks, read is two ticks in the accent colour.
sending and failed use the chat-timeline strings. A failed message opens message-actions with retry.
Another Matrix client does not send chat.bipe.delivered. A DM with such a client shows sent, then read.
